text:
jamie: Heads-up — we're planning a change to the route annotation payload that the internal API accepts. Goal: surface cost_center and route_name to the console for better quota attribution. This will change the header encoding the SDKs currently parse (current: compact token; proposal: base64-JSON). Plan is a gateway shim + staggered SDK updates. Thoughts?
sasha: Can the gateway keep a transparent fallback? Some customers use the compact token directly in proxies, we shouldn't break them without a fallback.
lee: Quotas team concern: if parsers reject old tokens we'll lose attribution and spike unknown buckets. We need a mapping path to preserve existing ledger keys.
morgan: TS SDK note — parser today assumes a single comma-delimited blob. Base64-JSON will be a breaking parse change. I recommend: opt-in parser flag in 1.0.0 (major), and a small helper library to decode both forms.
taylor: From Console POV this is useful — with JSON we can display route_name and cost_center as first-class columns in per-route dashboards. But we need guaranteed stable route_id for historical continuity.
jamie: Proposed rollout: 1) gateway accepts both headers: X-Rd-Route (legacy) and X-Rd-Route-V2 (new). 2) gateway emits canonical X-Rd-Route-Id for downstream quota/telemetry. 3) canary the shim for 2 weeks, then enable global with feature flag. deprecate legacy header after 8 weeks.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: start=1712350400 end=1712350800 (eng-platform/gateway/shim v0.1).
sasha: Telemetry will need a crosswalk table from legacy token -> (route_name,cost_center,route_id). Without that, historical metrics split across two keys. Ping @telemetry please.
telemetry: We'll build the crosswalk; we need samples of legacy tokens and expected decoded semantics. Recommend keeping token passthrough for 8 weeks so we can backfill aggregates.
morgan: SDK release plan draft: TS major (parser replace), Python minor with built-in fallback (no breaking), Go minor with env opt-in. We'll publish migration guide and cookbooks. assign alex to docs PR.
 taylor: UX ask: add a console banner during rollout showing % of traffic with new format and a link to migration docs. Also add a toggle to hide legacy-derived routes so customers can validate clean view.
jamie: Action list: (1) eng-platform implement shim + emit X-Rd-Route-Id (lee). (2) telemetry create crosswalk and sampling plan (telemetry). (3) SDKs: TS major bump + helper lib, py fallback, go opt-in (morgan, sasha, alex). (4) console banner + toggle (taylor). Start canary next Tue. I'll draft the deprecation email (30d notice) and the changelog entries. :+1:
